verdict.rationale: LegalOS publishes public blog guides relevant to founders. One maps the 10 EB-1 criteria to engineering careers, covering what wins and how to build the record; another explains startup H-1B sponsorship eligibility, cost, timeline and pitfalls. A free USCIS fee calculator adds practical process help. Missing for 10: evidence of a substantial library beyond a couple of posts, founder-specific guides (e.g., O-1 for founders), real case examples, and explicit confirmation the content is ungated; the eligibility checker looks more like lead intake than open guidance.
